title: Progress in the application of graphene-based nanomaterials for gas adsorption and mitigation of air pollution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31032-31059
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04635A, Review Article

Graphene-based materials (GBMs) have emerged as versatile and efficient candidates for gas adsorption and air pollution mitigation, particularly targeting COx, NOx, SOx, and volatile organic compounds (VOCs).
